rubrics.justification: The model correctly stated that no image was available to it and did not fabricate embryo morphology. It appropriately refrained from making unsupported claims.

It integrated age, ovarian reserve, endometrial thickness, BMI, male factor, prior cycle history, and lifestyle factors into prognosis well, though interaction with actual embryo morphology was necessarily limited.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with age-related aneuploidy appropriately driving prognosis. Minor overreach appears in some lifestyle-effect statements and adjunctive therapy discussion.

Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based (SET counseling, age-related aneuploidy discussion, consideration of PGT-A), but suggesting intralipids/steroids despite no indication and implying strong routine benefit from PGT-A lowers alignment.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer counseling, lifestyle modification, luteal support, and future-cycle planning, though some recommendations are somewhat generic and not tightly prioritized.
